CHEAT SHEET

How do we build a question?

ACTION VERB

Wh-word + do/does + subject + verb?

Where does Leo train?
HOW OLD / WHOSE + TO BE

How old + is/are + subject?
Whose + noun + is/are + subject?

How old is the coach?
Whose bag is it?
WHO DOES THE ACTION?

Who + verb-s + the rest?

Who plays volleyball?
HOW MANY + HAVE GOT

How many + noun + have/has + subject + got?

How many balls has he got?
